P.name: Tailwind
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Janna''' grants {{sti|ms|{{as|6% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} to nearby allied {{tip|champions}} that are facing in the direction of her location.
P.description2: '''Janna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Zephyr|Janna}}'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|30% of her '''bonus''' movement speed}}.

Q.name: Howling Gale
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' summons a whirlwind at her current location that charges up over 3 seconds, increasing its range, speed, damage, and {{tip|airborne|knock up}} duration every second over the duration. ''Howling Gale's'' direction is determined by this cast.
Q.description2: ''Howling Gale'' can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 195}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Second|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|55+10*3 to 195+30*3}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Janna''' launches the whirlwind in the direction she targeted over {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{pp|type=seconds charged|0.5 to 1.25|0 to 1.5 by 0.1}} seconds.

W.name: Zephyr
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' sends an air elemental at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 175}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' movement speed)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 36}}% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}}}}

E.name: Eye of the Storm
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Janna's''' abilities {{tip|slow}} or {{tip|airborne|knock up}} at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, 20% of ''Eye of the Storm's'' cooldown is refunded. This may occur once per spell cast.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' grants the target allied champion or {{tip|turret}}, or herself, a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds.
E.description3: While the shield holds, the target gains {{sti|attack damage|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.

R.name: Monsoon
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' unleashes a blast that {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} all nearby enemies to up to 875 units over {{fd|0.5}} seconds based on their proximity, though not through terrain.
R.description2: '''Janna''' also {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and nearby allies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
